title: Editor's computer hit by the same electromagnetic anomalies

tellings.quote: my editor encountered the exact same electromagnetic anomalies experienced by skinwalker visitors on his computer
My editor, when he was making our original Skinwalker Ranch vlog when we came 4 years ago, his screen froze up and it never did that and it got all static-y and weird
tellings.difference: Says the screen froze and went static-y, and that the vlog was made 4 years ago.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the host's editor's computer acting up while he edited the Skinwalker vlog about 2022.

as_told.title: Host's editor's screen froze while editing the Skinwalker vlog

plain: In 2022, while Michels's video editor on the East Coast was cutting their film about Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah known for reports of strange events, his computer screen froze and went full of static, which it had never done before. Michels tells this himself, twice, as something his editor went through. He says it matched the electrical trouble that visitors to the ranch report, as if the effect followed the footage home.
